top_categories.workout_context: 13,333ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
137ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
Race-pace efforts that mimic GFNY Lourdes Tourmalet's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before June.

Road-specific control matters at GFNY Lourdes Tourmalet. Practice on brutal Pyrenean paved climbs: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 97 miles.
At GFNY Lourdes Tourmalet, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
13,333ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of GFNY Lourdes Tourmalet. Train it until it feels boring.
At mile 60 of 97, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 97 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at GFNY Lourdes Tourmalet. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Low-cadence force work supports 13,333ft of climbing when the grade lowers cadence. Practice controlled torque while preserving good form.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on brutal Pyrenean paved climbs can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for GFNY Lourdes Tourmalet’s 97 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: GFNY Lourdes Tourmalet includes meaningful altitude exposure. Reduced oxygen availability can affect sustainable power, pacing, and recovery. Use a conservative upper-mountain pacing plan, test any travel or acclimatization strategy before the event, and plan layers for changing conditions. Do not begin iron or other supplements without clinician-guided testing. High-altitude chill; Gale-force summit winds.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at GFNY Lourdes Tourmalet rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on brutal pyrenean paved climbs to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on VO2max, TT Threshold, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 97 miles of brutal pyrenean paved climbs in Lourdes, Hautes-Pyrénées, France.
